The command-line tools Omarchy's shell indicators drive — volume, brightness, power profile and removable media.
Omarchy's Quickshell widgets do not talk to PipeWire, backlight sysfs or
power-profiles-daemon directly; they shell out to the small CLIs Omarchy's own
bin/omarchy-audio-*, omarchy-brightness-* and power commands wrap. Without
these the bar still renders, but its volume and brightness controls silently
do nothing when clicked. Verifiable on the built image: each tool is on PATH.
